title: Blending two consonants together: fr, st and mp
examples: Why do I miss a letter in stop?

explain.say: Look at the frog on the board. The word frog starts with two consonants side by side. Consonants are the letters that are not a, e, i, o or u. When two sit together, you hear both sounds.

draw.text: Blending two consonants together: fr, st and mp

explain.say: The first part glows: f, the first sound in fish. Keep it going, like a soft wind. Then slide straight into the next sound without stopping. Ready?
Now r, the first sound in rabbit. Slide from the f sound into the r sound, again and again, like a little engine starting up. Can you hear both sounds? Four taps, four sounds: frog!
Here is stop. It starts with s and t together. Hiss like a snake, then tap the t. You hear both! Then the o and the p. Tap four times and blend. Can you read it?
Two consonants can sit at the end too. Look at jump: m and p together. Hum the m, then pop the p. Four taps, four sounds: jump! Fantastic. Now jump up and say it!

faq.a: Consonants are all the letters that are not vowels. The vowels are a, e, i, o and u, so b, c, d, f, g and the rest are consonants.
It is two or three consonants side by side where you still hear each sound, like s and t in stop, or f and r in frog.

faq.q: Why do I miss a sound in words like frog?
faq.a: The two sounds rush past quickly, so one can hide. Tap one finger for each sound, and you will catch them both.
asks: Why do I read fog instead of frog?

faq.q: How do I read the end of jump?
faq.a: Hum the m sound, then pop the p sound. You hear both. Tap them on two fingers.
Lots! Starting blends like bl, cr, sp and tr, and ending blends like nd, st and lt. A teacher or grown-up can help you make a blend wall.

facts: The word frog has four letters and four sounds.
In a consonant blend, like st in stop, you can hear the sound of each letter.

quiz.say: How many sounds are in the word stop?
quiz.why: Stop has four sounds: s, t, o and p. You hear both s and t.

wrong.0: The s and t are both heard, so there is one more than three.
wrong.2: Stop has four letters, and each makes one sound.

quiz.say: Which word starts with two consonants?
quiz.show: Which word starts with two consonants?
quiz.why: Frog starts with f and r, two consonants.

wrong.1: Fog starts with just one consonant, f, then a vowel.
wrong.2: Egg starts with a vowel, e.
